title: Incorrect results from `warp_specialize=True`
review_note: The issue shows the exact before/after IR swap and confirms that disabling the pass restores results; the merged patch blocks local-load movement across write side effects and adds that barrier pattern as a regression.

title: Multicta matmul miscompiles
review_note: The report isolates two-CTA lowering, and the linked patch states that the M=64 two-CTA layout was wrong and changes the corresponding tensor-memory coordinate bases and mode representation.

title: RAW hazard with pipelined wgmma and LHS in register
review_note: PRs 9514 and 9530 make the Triton PTX relation explicit and place moves before the fence, yet the report still observes a SASS hazard with ptxas 13.1 and attributes final success to ptxas 13.3. The ptxas repair is not archived, so the combined repair chain remains incomplete.

title: tl.store(i1, i32) implicitly casts int32 as int8 lead unexpected behavior
review_note: The issue's TTIR isolates truncation at store, and the merged patch names #9991 and changes precisely that cast order.

title: [Blackwell SM100] RuntimeError: misaligned address on tcgen05.mma
review_note: The Triton repair PR was not merged, and the downstream workaround does not correct Triton's allocator, so no landed upstream repair chain exists.

title: `make_tensor_descriptor` + `num_stages >= 3` produces `CUDA_ERROR_MISALIGNED_ADDRESS`
review_note: The reported failure begins only with multistaging, and the patch's alignment gate plus end-to-end test directly distinguish the unsafe TMA path from the repaired non-TMA path.

title: Probabilistic illegal memory access from a kernel with multiple tl.dot on H100 (sm_90)
review_note: No fixing commit, repaired transformation, before/after code contrast, or issue-specific regression is linked to the non-reproduction on main. The observed recovery therefore cannot support an implemented-relation-to-repair chain.

title: [BUG] sm_103 (B300): `tl.dot` chunked-recurrence kernel is non-deterministic with `num_warps∈{4,8}, num_stages∈{2,3}` — reproduces on Triton 3.7.0, i.e. NOT fixed by #9615 / #9871's fix
review_note: Neither maintainers nor the reporter identify which main-branch commit fixed the behavior. Without the responsible source delta, generated-code contrast, and matching regression, the fixed-version run cannot establish the repair relationship.

title: [BUG][AMD] fp8 e4m3fnuz/e5m2fnuz NaN (byte 0x80) silently decodes to fp16/bf16 -0.0 instead of NaN on non-CDNA3 GPUs
review_note: The issue enumerates the three decoders, and the merged patch adds explicit tests and guards for their exact 0x80 behavior.

title: [Bug] Two `tl.dot` chained through one accumulator in a K-loop compute wrong results on sm_103 (B300)
review_note: The issue's controls isolate a shared accumulator on tcgen05, and the merged patch explicitly reconstructs that identity and blocks stage movement when its dependency graph crosses the loop boundary.

title: warpgroup_mma_wait does not properly synchronize across warpgroups
review_note: The re-applied patch explicitly fixes #11047 and adds the report's multi-warpgroup kernel plus LLVM barrier checks.

title: inline_asm_elementwise emits does not correctly handle replicated elements
review_note: PR 11089 was not merged, and the open discussion has no alternative landed semantics or regression.

title: triton seems to not lower a float8 e5m2 transposed store correctly in some conditions
review_note: The issue rules out numerical and barrier explanations and reports the toolchain-version contrast; the merged downstream patch removes only the triggering code shape and explicitly scopes itself as a workaround.

title: [TritonGPU] OptimizeThreadLocality miscompiles loop accumulator with an additional in-loop use
review_note: The issue and patch identify the same omitted use check; the one-line guard and negative regression preserve the path whose in-loop observation was miscompiled.

title: Pipelined dot-input load appears before gdc_wait and produces incorrect results with PDL
review_note: The report localizes a load hoisted across gdc_wait, but the responsible source transformation, corrective patch, and fixed-version execution are unavailable.
